name: Button
purpose: Triggers an action. GOV.UK: primary (green) and secondary (grey) levels; square corners; 2px bottom shadow; yellow focus state.

accessibility.focus: yellow fill + black text + 3px transparent outline (visible in forced-colors); never outline:none without replacement
accessibility.notes: disabled via aria-disabled to stay perceivable/focusable per GOV.UK v5 guidance

antiPatterns: green button on non-white surface without re-checking contrast
using a link styled as a button without role/semantics

provenance.$finding: F5 — no figma_node: the engine's hub identity is Figma-shaped; code-source systems need a package+path hub
